region: integer half-open x0,x1,y0,y1 rectangle in an immutable non-overlapping full-image partition; default 16x16 tiles
sample_ownership: kernel owns next consecutive per-pixel sample index; no skip, replay, overlap or policy-supplied index

streams.derivation: first eight big-endian SHA256 bytes of UTF8 tc-r1-v1|20261007|scene_id|frame_id|replicate|stream
streams.pbrt_seed: low 31 bits of full derived seed; reject projected collisions across frozen run identities
streams.sampler: pinned native IndependentSampler PCG sequence Hash(pixel,seed), advance sample_index*65536+dimension; no samples-per-pixel-dependent permutation
streams.separation: allocation and production use distinct identities; adapter does not claim independent optional stopping merely from distinct seeds

state.sample_count: total completed camera samples in region
state.samples_per_pixel: uniform committed per-pixel count in partition member
state.mean: RGB area-average per-pixel native sample means, null before any samples
state.variance: RGB area-average unbiased per-pixel sample variance, null below two samples
state.standard_error: RGB sqrt(sum(pixel_variance / pixel_count)) / region_area, null below two samples
state.recent_improvement: previous minus current sum of squared regional standard errors; signed, null if either snapshot undefined; uncertainty proxy, never reference error
state.estimated_sample_cost: seconds per completed camera sample for most recent committed request, measured around backend plus state/validation; null before work
state.charged_rays: sum of actual camera+generated continuation+visibility charges in region

accumulation: per-pixel count, RGB mean and second central moment via Welford; native box Film channel means checked with 1e-6+1e-5*maxabs tolerance; final image uses per-pixel means, no denoising/reweighting
accounting: verify independent per-sample class ledger and native query deltas; generated roulette-discarded continuations charged; no spp-derived ray estimates
failure: fail closed and stop; retain request/error/backend evidence; unknown unvalidated work explicitly marked unknown and never treated as zero or retried
stop: no rendering; immutable committed checkpoint with reason; no actions after stop
timing: end-to-end runner must additionally include observation/policy/dispatch/stopping/metric work; estimated_sample_cost is not the primary timed outcome
budget: complete requested native paths without truncation; return actual batch charges; common checkpoint/overshoot/time-cap enforcement remains integration-freeze prerequisite
estimator_limitation: native sample averages and SE are descriptive; data-dependent selection/stopping may bias finite-budget means and invalidate nominal SE coverage. This API does not establish unbiasedness; integration must bind estimator/stopping justification or limitations and independent correctness evidence before execution freeze
reference_access: no reference image, offline metric or future sample is part of requests or policy observations
